changes.summary: Expose a fixed-path sign-out subapp for directly inferred Eden clients and document Elysia 2 schema argument order
Provide fixed-route credentials APIs with inferred Eden request types and a package-owned manifest integration recipe
Document the required auth context session binding and protected account route
Delegate configurable credential routes through shared literal-path factories while retaining the same configuration and default endpoints
Document verified persistent credentials integration and correct Drizzle and migration APIs
Run auth setup according to the selected session store instead of always requiring PostgreSQL
Support existing Drizzle PostgreSQL clients for durable auth sessions

migration.instruction: Send client_credentials requests to /auth/api/token instead of /oauth2/token and update advertised enterprise token URLs. Keep authorization_code and refresh_token requests at /oauth2/token. Prefer auth({ oidc, apikeys }) for configuration validation. API-only consumers may explicitly keep tokenRoute: /oauth2/token if no OIDC handler uses that path.

changes.summary: Separate API credential token routes from OIDC and reject conflicting configuration
